content.text:
I fixed it: `v-for` over a `shallowReactive` array now passes each item through as it is. With your example, `item.aaa` stays a ref, so the template should print "object object". I didn't add a test for this case or run your playground example. The existing `renderList` tests still pass (7/7).

**Cause:** in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`, `renderList` wrapped every item of any reactive array with `toReactive()`. That made each item deeply reactive. Deep reactivity unwraps refs, so `item.aaa` came back as the string `'aaa1'`. A shallow reactive array should never wrap its items like this.

**Fix:** the items are only wrapped with `toReactive()` when the source array is reactive and not shallow, checked with `isShallow`. Deep reactive arrays behave as before.
